main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 3-bar return

statistic.name: t of per-bar forecast x excess

main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t >= 2 confirms; below 0 with t <= -2 rejects; at least 100 grid cases

decided_by: Confirm: the forecast-weighted mean excess 3-bar return is above 0 with t >= 2 over at least 100 grid cases.
reading: The coin's mean 3-bar return is taken over all its non-overlapping grid bars (positions 0, 3, 6, ... of every window, forward return inside the window), and the plan's 'fewer than 100 cases' is reported as not observable per the minimum-count rule.
